headline: WebkitPro
text: A modular, code-first PHP web framework for building multilingual, content-driven websites. It combines reusable frontend components with server-side routing, templates, centralized configuration, and CMS-like content management. Vite provides bundling, minification, and asset versioning of SCSS, JavaScript, and TypeScriptUnlike a traditional CMS, WebkitPro requires no administrative GUI and keeps the website structure, components, and content entirely code-driven.
